svg.title: How a new repository starts
svg.desc: copier copy writes the files of the project and runs no code of the blueprint. python3 .github/blueprint.py create, which every copy brings, makes the first commit on the branch main with a sign-off, creates the repository with gh repo create and pushes to it, applies the settings as code and shows the checklist. You take the steps that only a person can take, such as the release app and the secrets, and then the checks and the bots run.
